description: A phone review recording of a compared commit range names both endpoints in its saved view. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Open the diffs" means: wait (up to 30s) for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible, click the "Diffs" button in ".chat-workspace-actions" (if it is not visible, as on a phone, click the button "More options" instead and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"), and wait for the commit message. "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). Navigate to /c/review and open the diffs. Click ".commit-picker-trigger", then click "Compare range" in ".git-graph-container". Click its row containing "Base", then the row containing "Rename value20". The ".diff-rethink-range-overview" should be visible. Click the start button; wait for the stop button to be visible. Click the stop button and wait until it is sent. Call "range view"; it must return exactly "Files · {{BASE}} Base → {{SHORT}} · commit message {{SHORT}}".
